answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a jade as the anchor of the cost.
